prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective moving forward along a narrow path flanked by tall metal railings, surrounded by dense, foggy forest under a cloudy night sky. As the camera advances, it transitions into a series of red torii gates that line the pathway, creating a tunnel-like effect illuminated by soft ambient light filtering through the mist. The camera continues straight ahead, passing through the gates, which gradually become more illuminated by warm, glowing lanterns hanging from their structures. The path leads to an open courtyard with stone pavement, where the camera pans slightly to the left, revealing a traditional Japanese building with red lanterns casting a reddish hue over the area. The camera then moves forward again, entering another sequence of torii gates, this time more densely packed and brightly lit by the lanterns, enhancing the vivid red color against the dark surroundings. As the camera progresses, it veers off the main path into a dimly lit forested area, showcasing the natural environment with trees and underbrush shrouded in fog. The camera then returns to the torii-lined path, capturing the rhythmic repetition of the gates receding into the distance, before coming to a halt at a point where the path curves out of sight, enveloped by the eerie, misty atmosphere. Throughout the sequence, the camera maintains a steady, forward-moving angle, emphasizing the immersive experience of navigating through the serene yet mysterious setting of Fushimi Inari Taisha at night.
